faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Short answers to the questions we hear most.

items.q1: How long does the owner have to respond to a booking?
items.a1: Up to 24 hours. Past that with no response, the request expires automatically and no funds are deducted.
items.q2: Can I view the room before paying?
items.a2: Yes. Submit a booking, then schedule a visit through messages. Payment only happens once you're sure.
items.q3: What if my room is given to someone else?
items.a3: The room locks automatically when a booking is approved, so the owner can't accept other requests for the same room until the booking completes or is cancelled.
items.q4a: Bank transfer (BCA, Mandiri, BNI), e-wallets (GoPay, OVO, DANA), QRIS, and retail outlets (Indomaret, Alfamart).
items.a5: Payments are processed by a licensed payment provider. NgeKost never stores your card numbers or bank credentials.
items.q6: How do I list my kost?
items.a6: Register as an Owner, fill in property and room-type data, then submit for verification. It's free and completes within 3 business days.
items.q7: What does NgeKost cost for owners?
items.a7: Listing is free. Subscription plans start at Rp99,000/month for management features: automatic invoicing, Telegram notifications, and occupancy reports.
items.a8: Tenant payments land in your NgeKost balance, then disburse to your bank account within 24 business hours after confirmation.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing NgeKost you agree to these terms. If you disagree with any part, stop using the service. These terms apply to all users: renters, property owners, and visitors.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts and Responsibility
sections.body: You must provide accurate information when registering and keep your credentials confidential.
list: One person may hold one account.
Activity in your account is considered yours.
Report unauthorized use of your account immediately.

sections.heading: 3. Bookings and Payments
sections.body: A booking request becomes binding once the owner approves it. After approval, payment follows the stated deadline and the room is locked for you.
list: Payments are processed by a licensed payment provider.
Refunds follow the cancellation policy on each property page.
NgeKost never stores card numbers or bank credentials.

sections.heading: 4. NgeKost's Role
sections.body: NgeKost is an intermediary platform. We verify owner identity and property data completeness, but we are not a party to the rental agreement between owner and tenant. Disputes over the room, facilities, or comfort are settled between both parties; we assist mediation through the Help Center.

sections.heading: 5. User Content
sections.body: Reviews, photos, and messages you send must reflect real experiences. We remove fake content, hate speech, and unsolicited ads, and may suspend repeat offenders.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to Terms
sections.body: These terms may change at any time. Material changes are announced by email or notification at least 7 days before taking effect. Continuing to use the service after that date means you accept the new version.

sectionsPrivacy.heading: 1. Data We Collect
sectionsPrivacy.body: When you register and use NgeKost, we collect:
list: Property and transaction data (bookings, invoices, payments).
Technical data: IP address, device type, and usage logs.

sectionsPrivacy.heading: 2. How We Use Data
sectionsPrivacy.body: Data is used to run the service: processing bookings, issuing invoices, sending Telegram notifications, and verifying properties. We also use it to improve search and show relevant recommendations.

sectionsPrivacy.heading: 3. Sharing with Third Parties
sectionsPrivacy.body: We do not sell personal data. Data is shared on a limited basis with:
list: Notification providers (Telegram) for messages you subscribe to.
Legal authorities when required by regulation.

sectionsPrivacy.heading: 4. Storage and Security
sectionsPrivacy.body: Data is stored on servers in Indonesia and encrypted in transit. Internal access is limited to teams who need it. Retention follows transaction bookkeeping obligations, up to 10 years for financial data.

sectionsPrivacy.heading: 5. Your Rights
sectionsPrivacy.body: You can request a copy, correction, or deletion of your personal data anytime via halo@ngekost.id. Requests are processed within 14 business days. Deleting your account doesn't delete transactions the law requires us to keep.

sectionsPrivacy.heading: 6. Data Protection Contact
sectionsPrivacy.body: Send privacy questions to halo@ngekost.id with the subject "Privacy". We respond within 3 business days.
